# Fenced Examples

Fences hide their contents from the task scanner.

```text
- [ ] FENCED-1 Not a real task
- [x] FENCED-2 Also not real
```

Some prose between the two fences.

~~~
- [ ] FENCED-3 The tilde fence is opaque too
~~~

## Real Tasks

- [ ] FENCE-9 The only real task
  It sits after both fences and must be the single block we see.
